from pathlib import Path
import os,signal,subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');test=repo/'tests/test_application_answer_resolution.py'
base='97cc0982f4a1f656ebd053872e61f26eb9f0142b'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
if git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip()!=base or git('rev-parse','origin/main').strip()!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
prior=git('show','HEAD:tests/test_application_answer_resolution.py');now=test.read_text()
marker='async def test_sensitive_answer_never_fans_out_to_other_job_plans('
if not now.startswith(prior) or now.count(marker)!=1:raise SystemExit('TEST_STATE_CHANGED')
part=now[len(prior):]
old='''    parser=_Parser(ApplicationAnswerResolutionProposal(
        canonical_key=key,resolution_kind=ApplicationAnswerResolutionKind.FACT,
        value=value,evidence_text="I explicitly confirm this information.",
        unambiguous=True))
    calls=[]
    result=await resolve_application_answer(
      ApplicationAnswerResolutionCommand(SUBJECT,original.item_id,
          "I explicitly confirm this information.",NOW),'''
new='''    evidence = ("Yes, I am authorized to work." if value
                else "No, I do not need visa sponsorship.")
    parser=_Parser(ApplicationAnswerResolutionProposal(
        canonical_key=key,resolution_kind=ApplicationAnswerResolutionKind.FACT,
        value=value,evidence_text=evidence,
        unambiguous=True))
    calls=[]
    result=await resolve_application_answer(
      ApplicationAnswerResolutionCommand(SUBJECT,original.item_id,
          evidence,NOW),'''
if part.count(old)!=1:raise SystemExit('TEST_ANCHOR_MISSING')
test.write_text(prior+part.replace(old,new,1))
def check(args,seconds):
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','--maxfail=1','--tb=short',*args],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=seconds)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=7)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);o,e=p.communicate()
  print('TIMEOUT',args,o[-2000:],flush=True);raise SystemExit(124)
 print('TEST',args,'EXIT',p.returncode,o[-3000:],e[-700:],flush=True)
 return p.returncode
if check(['tests/test_application_answer_resolution.py'],110):raise SystemExit('SAFETY_GATE_FAILED')
if check(['tests/test_application_answers.py','tests/test_human_attention_queue.py'],200):raise SystemExit('ADJACENT_GATE_FAILED')
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','tests/test_application_answer_resolution.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','test: guard sensitive answer resolution against cross-job fanout'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH',git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip(),flush=True)
